method: Maintainer-agent static trace/report audit, separate from preserved raw same-model grades. No new model grading or live testing.
scope: Four synthetic fixtures in two paired implementation/transport families; three fresh contexts each. Third campaign is a repair retest on already observed cases, not a holdout.

evaluator_exceptions.type: Grader changed only a line-range en dash to a hyphen; exact-quote validator rejected it. Separate adjudication.json corrects the quote without altering raw grade or report.

Grader Grep used a mistyped absolute skill path outside its temp workspace. Restricted CLI denied the request; no external content returned. Reviewer trace was clean and all substantive grades were met. Raw policy failure retained.

interpretation: All 12 reviewer reports meet the exercised criteria after the documented quote adjudication. The full automated harness did not strictly pass. This supports bounded source-review utility, not general model qualification or security certification.
limits: Two paired synthetic implementation families, not four independent product architectures.
Same-model graders and a maintainer-agent audit can share systematic blind spots.
Known-fixture repair iteration; future qualification needs fresh holdouts.
No native skill routing, live MCP behavior, web advisory discovery, deployed controls or no-skill baseline tested.
